title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Navier–Stokes Proof Allegations Rock AI & Math Community: Mathematicians Tristan Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge achieved major progress on Navier–Stokes using Claude and Codex, triggering a fiery debate after allegations surfaced that OpenAI internal teams attempted to scoop the proof using private chat logs.

DeepMind Launches AlphaGenome Atlas Mapping 9 Billion DNA Variants: Demis Hassabis announced DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas, an AI database charting all 9 billion single-letter DNA variants to predict mutation impacts on human health and disease.

Anthropic Incubator Team Revealed Behind Claude Code & MCP: Insider reports revealed Anthropic operates a fast-paced 20-person internal experimental team that accepts 70–80% project failure rates to incubate breakout products like Claude Code, MCP, and Claude Design.

France Football Announces Official 2026 Ballon d'Or Nominees: The 30 nominees for the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or were officially unveiled, featuring Harry Kane, Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappé, Jude Bellingham, and Erling Haaland.

Heroic Rescue at Shanghai GT Race Sparks Safety & Organizer Outrage: Netherlands driver Hartog halted his race to single-handedly rescue a British driver from a burning GT race car after venue safety marshals failed to respond effectively.

items.title: @hosseeb: OpenAI & Math Community Erupt over Navier-Stokes Proof Claims
items.body: Mathematicians Tristan Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge made breakthrough progress on Navier-Stokes using Claude and Codex, triggering high-profile accusations that OpenAI attempted to scoop the work using private chat logs.

items.title: @demishassabis: DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas for Human Genomic Variant Mapping
items.body: Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome Atlas, mapping the predicted biological impact of all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes to advance genetic disease research.

items.title: @choblin29: Anthropic Incubator Team Yields Claude Code, MCP, and Claude Design
